reasoning_content:
The addon api Dockerfile needs test-deps stage to run `uv sync --locked --dev` requiring uv.lock in api dir - which doesn't exist. And builder stage uses pip wheel with private index. Per guide, rewrite builder stage to build local wheels. But the test-deps stage runs first? Actually build stages are only executed if they're part of the target's dependency chain. The final stage FROM demospipes-base-api; builder stage feeds final. test-deps stage isn't referenced by final, so BuildKit might not build it... but a single-stage `docker build .` builds all stages? No — with BuildKit, docker build builds the target stage (last stage). Unreferenced earlier stages are not built unless referenced. Actually the last stage is `final`; `test-deps` is not in its chain, so it won't build. Let me verify.

Let me rewrite the builder stage of the addon Dockerfile per the guide and fix the FROM to local tag.

action.command:
cat > /tmp/addon_api_Dockerfile <<'EOF'
# Stage 2: build stage
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /wheels

COPY ./api/pyproject.toml .
COPY ./api/demospipes_addon_bmds_api/ ./demospipes_addon_bmds_api/
COPY ./data-structures/ ./data-structures/
COPY ./data_structures/ ./data_structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ /data-structures/ && \
    pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ /data_structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --find-links /tmp/local-wheels/ \
    --wheel-dir /wheels .

# Stage 3: final stage
FROM demospipes-base-api:v1.18.127-main-ce4cc11 AS final

WORKDIR /wheels
COPY --from=builder /wheels .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=. ./*.whl && \
    rm -rf /wheels

ENV HOME=/home/user
ENV PREFECT_HOME=$HOME/.prefect

RUN useradd user -u 1001 -g 0 -m && \
    mkdir -p "$PREFECT_HOME" && chown -R user "$PREFECT_HOME"

USER user

WORKDIR /app

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["uvicorn", "demospipes_api.app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
EOF
cp /tmp/addon_api_Dockerfile /tmp/addon_api/api/Dockerfile
cd /tmp/addon_api && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 nohup docker build -t demospipes-addon-bmds-api:latest -f api/Dockerfile . > /tmp/build_addon_api.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 60; tail -15 /tmp/build_addon_api.log
